summary: Iteration 2 — P0 astrology + Deity-of-Day ribbon + Muhūrta alarm + i18n. Full backend + frontend regression run. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass (7 regression from iteration 1 + 8 new for /api/panchangam/timings, /api/kundali/generate incl. 422 validation, /api/horoscope for Mesha/Vrishabha/Mithuna, /api/deities/ganesha/names). Frontend: /panchangam renders Deity-of-Day ribbon + new 4-tab bar (panchangam / muhurta / kundali / horoscope). All four panes mount without console errors. MuhurtaTimings shows 7 slots incl. Rāhu Kāla, Yama Gaṇḍa, Gulika, Abhijit, Brahma, Amṛta, Durmuhūrta. MuhurtaAlarm alarm-test-btn opens overlay above audio player, dismiss/ok buttons work — no pointer-event conflict. Config toggle reveals ringtone/lead/duration/vibrate settings. Kundali form submitted (dob=1990-05-15, time=08:30, Hyderabad) returned chart with Lagna, Janma Rāśi, Nakshatra, 9 planets, 9 dashas + 4325-char AI reading. Horoscope for Mesha returned all 5 sections + lucky color/number + mantra. Deity-of-Day japa button on ribbon adds +108 to dj_japa_counts.shiva in localStorage and shows toast. i18n switcher (Radix DropdownMenu) works — clicking lang-option-te live-updates all tile titles and descriptions to Telugu, switcher label updates from 'English' to 'తెలుగు', dj_lang persists in localStorage across reload; verified for te, hi, ta, en. Regression: /japa loads, /rama-koti renders (canvas is behind write-mode toggle by default), /deities shows exactly 34 tiles.

issues: Muhūrta Alarms bell toggles (alarm-toggle-<key>) share visual style — active vs. inactive state distinction relies solely on subtle icon change; adding a filled background for enabled state would improve affordance.
Deity name text (e.g. 'SHIVA') visually overlaps with the small Devanagari overlay 'शिव' on the ribbon — kerning/positioning could be improved.

critical_code_review_comments: KundaliMaker frontend uses a hardcoded 18-city list for lat/lng/tz; no free-form place input or geocoder. Acceptable for MVP but limits global users.
Kundali POST is slow (~28s end-to-end because of LLM reading generation). Consider streaming the reading or returning chart immediately and reading via a follow-up call for better UX.
MuhurtaAlarm polls every 15s using setInterval — fine, but if tab is backgrounded browsers throttle to 1min. If precise alarm firing matters, use Notification API + Service Worker.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') (carried over from iteration 1). Prefer FastAPI lifespan handler.

Panchāngam/timings still use approximate math (documented). Sunrise/sunset in timings response differ slightly from /api/panchangam response (06:21 vs 06:12) — same date. Slight inconsistency worth harmonising.
Home.jsx tile list hardcodes sanskrit strings (e.g. 'देवाः', 'भक्तपरिचयः') irrespective of lang — acceptable since sanskrit is universal but ensure this is intentional.
server.py file size and Home.jsx (364 lines) are within limits, no split needed yet.
test_credentials: N/A — all astrology features are guest-accessible per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ prefixed user name in Kundali generate; no persistent data created (Kundali only saved when authenticated).
